blocks.html:
Below you will find a series of initiatives implemented at USI in order to make the academic community more sustainable and attentive to the surrounding environment and society.

  • For members of its own community, USI proposes the so-called environmental volunteering (or eco-volunteering): it includes all those actions aimed at the recovery and protection of natural resources at risk. In agreement with various organizations active in the Ticino area (and beyond), USI members will be able to donate their time, energy and commitment to do good to the surrounding environment. Among the organizations contacted, the Gruppo Verde Speranza (in Italian only) deals with the collection of urban waste in the Mendrisiotto and Lugano area. This group of young volunteers offers a large calendar of events for which it will be necessary to book your participation (at no cost) in order to better organize the management of the participants.
  • USI, every year and in collaboration with the Red Cross Transfusion Service of Southern Switzerland, organises two appointments for blood donation at the Lugano and Mendrisio campuses.

Bikecoin 2026

From 1 October to 15 December 2026, the entire USI community is invited to take part in the Bikecoin challenge.

Earn Bikecoins for every journey between home and work made, even if only partly, by bike or on foot. At the end of the challenge, the top-ranked participant in the overall leaderboard will win a voucher from the USI Sports Service and a shopping voucher, worth a total of around 500 CHF. There are also 20 canteen vouchers up for grabs each month in October and November, to be drawn from all participants who have accumulated at least 1,500 Bikecoins in the respective month. Finally, at the end of the challenge, 5 USI Sports Service vouchers will also be drawn from all participants who have accumulated at least 6,500 Bikecoins in total.

You can also contribute to the shared goal: once a total of 40,000 km has been covered by all challenge participants, USI will commit to improving bicycle parking facilities at its campuses.

To take part in the challenge, you need to download the Mobalt app. Full details are available here.
